title: 第三章 想要退婚的李洛
content_zh:
四匹狮马兽拉动着车辇平稳的奔驰于南风城宽敞的街道上，街道上如林般树立的建筑飞快的后退。
车辇内颇为的宽敞，温暖舒适，而李洛与姜青娥，便是各坐在茶几的两侧。
两人并没有太多的话语，李洛上车便是闭目养神，而姜青娥则是精致如玉般的脸颊上，引得那脸颊更为的晶莹剔透。
安静持续了许久，姜青娥那修长浓密的睫毛突然眨了眨，抬起俏脸，金色眼瞳注视着面前的李洛，道：“看来我前些年在南风学府说的话，给你带来了一些麻烦。”
“我很抱歉。”
李洛闻言，睁开了双目，他望着面前那张漂亮精致中又带着掩饰不住的凌厉与强势的脸蛋，笑道：“你这道歉可看不出半点诚意。”
“如果你有诚意的话，就允许我把婚约给解除掉。”
姜青娥随意的翻动着书页，道：“难道这就是传说中的退婚？可是在话本戏剧中，主动提起这个不应该是我吗？你会不会搞反了顺序？”
对于她这突然的冷幽默，李洛也是有点哭笑不得。
姜青娥抬起头，看了李洛一眼，淡淡的道：“怎么？怕这个婚约给你带来更大的麻烦？”
李洛沉默了一下，摇了摇头，道：“是怕耽搁你，你一个女孩子，何必背一个没必要的婚约？这婚约怎么来的，你又不是不知道，我老爹因此这些年被我娘打了多少顿？”
“我老爹这事搞得荒唐，挨打我其实也赞成，但关键是凭啥每次我娘打我爹的时候，都要带上我也挨一顿？！”
说到最后，李洛的神情也是有些怨念。
想起那个对自己很温柔，却插着腰，柳眉倒竖的优雅女人将家中一大一小的两个男人打得鸡飞狗跳的场景，即便是姜青娥，此时都忍不住的红润小嘴微微的一弯，旋即又是平复下去。
“我不怕。”她摇摇头道。
李洛头疼的道：“那你以后遇见喜欢的人怎么办？你这简直就是瞎搞。”
姜青娥淡笑道：“未必会遇见吧，我的眼光还是挺高的，而且你我已经有过婚约，我也不可能对其他人有什么心思。”
李洛盯着姜青娥，声音中猛的多了一些怒意：“姜青娥，你究竟在想些什么？我知道我爹娘对你很好，你对他们很感激，可是你没必要用这种方式来表达你的感谢，你当我是什么？你用来表达感谢的工具吗？”
“这个婚约，你同意了，那我有同意过吗？”
李洛突然的发火，让得姜青娥也是怔了怔，她那纯粹的金色眼瞳注视着前者的面庞，安静了片刻，然后微微低头的道：“对不起，这件事情的确是我没有考虑到你的感受。”

李洛见状，道：“既然如此，那这个婚约...”
“不过...”
姜青娥抬起俏脸，看着李洛认真的道：“你也应该知道，在咱们家里的规矩是怎么样的，如果双方出现了意见分歧，那么就先打一场，然后赢家享有决议权。”
这个规矩，是李洛的娘定下来的，这么多年，一直都通行于家里的任何事情，所以每一次当她与李洛老爹出现意见分歧的时候，她就会挽起袖子，直接将老爹拖进训练室。
“所以如果你对婚约抱有很大的意见，我们可以到家后去训练室，然后按照规矩来。”姜青娥说道。
李洛的神情顿时僵硬下来，面色变幻不定，最后他咬着牙，指着姜青娥悲愤的道：“姜青娥，你不要太过分了，我现在一个十印境的初学者，跟你一个地煞将打个屁啊？！”
这人族修行，开启相宫后，便是筑基的十印境，十印境后为相师境，可唯有相师境后，这修行方才是真正的开始登堂入室。
相师境后，有三大境。
拜将，封侯，称王。
封侯，称王太远，而这拜将，则分为上下两阶，上为天罡将，下为地煞将...而姜青娥，则是处于地煞将的层次。
而能够以这个年龄，达到拜将境，姜青娥的修炼天赋，绝对是让得无数人为之震撼，甚至已有人猜测，这大夏国最年轻的封侯者的记录，恐怕都会将由她来打破。
可现在，这地煞将的姜青娥，竟是要处于十印境的李洛跟她打一场...
李洛真的担心到时候万一她收不住力，直接一巴掌将他给呼死了。
姜青娥收起了桌上的书籍，有些遗憾的道：“看来你不同意这个方式，那就没办法了。”
李洛气抖冷，这个世界还能不能好了，我想退个婚都这么难吗？
他无力的靠着车窗，目光则是望着姜青娥那光洁精致的容颜，特别是那一对金色的眼瞳，纯粹得让人有些迷醉。
他叹了一口气，声音低了许多：“青娥姐，我们也算是相处了许多年，但我明白，你对我，其实并没有那种男女间的感情。”
“没有感情作为基础，这种婚约，又有什么意思？”
姜青娥沉默了片刻，道：“虽然我想说，你明天才十七岁而已，装什么老成...”
“不过你说的的确是有些道理，但我对于其他人，并没有任何的兴趣，可对你，我至少不排斥。”

李洛苦笑一声，道：“青娥姐，那封婚约，更多的是因为你对我爹娘的感激，我相信你对他们的感情，比起对我要强烈不知道多少，但这种感激，我真的不太需要。”
说罢，李洛垂下头，缓缓道：“我知道让你收回婚约或许不太现实，但是……”
他抬起头直视着姜青娥的眼睛，“我希望你能给自己，也给我一个机会。”
李洛顿了顿，接着说：“我们可以做一场交易，你在我还没足够的能力前，帮我掌控住洛岚府，如果等我接手洛岚府时，你能让它没有多大的损失，那么作为感谢，我将婚约还给你，如何？”
姜青娥没有说话，只是那修长的玉指轻轻的在桌面上有节奏的点动着，安静持续了好半晌，最终她轻声道：“李洛，你真不喜欢我？”
李洛一滞，旋即他深吸一口气，道：“青娥姐，你可能低估了你的吸引力以及优秀，对于这个年龄段的人来说，你的魅力是通杀型，我如果说不喜欢，那可真是太违心与虚伪了。”
“但是，我不需要这种婚约。”
姜青娥柳眉轻轻一挑，小手突然拍在了茶几上。
李洛一惊，连忙挪动屁股退后，道：“咱们好好商量，可不要动手。”
姜青娥白了他一眼，淡淡的道：“李洛，一段时间不见，你口才倒是见长，不过你说的算是有几分道理，我可以把此事当做一场交易，等你要接手洛岚府时，我会把它完完整整的交给你，那个时候，你就将婚约退给我。”
李洛闻言，顿时如释重负的松了一口气，但同时在那心里最深处，也不可控制的出现了一些莫名的失落，这让得他不由得暗骂了自己一声，真是贱...
“你今日的说辞，倒是让我有些刮目相看，看来你也不再是什么小孩子了。”
李洛有些怒了：“小孩子？我哪里小了？”
姜青娥没有搭理他这话，只是似笑非笑的盯着他，道：“不过李洛，我最后可还是要再提醒你一句，你真的打算要进行这场交易吗？这份婚约，一旦退了回来，恐怕这辈子，你就真没一点希望了。”
李洛双目一眯，他双臂按着茶几，直起了身子，直接是俯视着姜青娥，两人的脸庞不过半尺左右的距离。
“姜青娥，这份婚约，我是真的一点不稀罕，因为未来，我想让你亲手再将婚约给我，而不是给我爹娘。”
姜青娥金色眼瞳倒映着李洛俊朗的面庞，她唇角的似笑非笑之意更浓了，她当然明白李洛的意思，这份婚约之所以退给她，是因为现在的她对他并没有男女间的喜欢之意，而以后，她再次将婚约给李洛时，就代表着她喜欢上了他。
“坐下。”她红唇微启。
一股莫名的力量凭空而现，直接是将李洛一屁股给按了回去，重重的坐在车板上，那力道让得后者忍不住的咧咧嘴。
于是先前的气势瞬间破功。

姜青娥则是托着香腮，有些慵懒的看了李洛一眼，道：“本事不大，口气倒是不小，这些年天骄也见多了，可还没人敢跟我说这种话。”
“李洛，不要好高骛远，你的目标太不切实际了，不过如果你真想试试，我不妨给你一个机会。”
她金色的眼瞳泛着光泽，神秘而深邃。
“我在圣玄星学府等你...这是第一步，而如果你连这一点都达不到，今日这些话，你就当做是年少气盛的叛逆心作祟，然后遗忘掉吧。”
李洛这一次没有再多说什么，他只是靠着车窗，眼目渐渐的闭拢，平静的道：“那你就等着吧。”
姜青娥眼瞳望着车窗缝隙外掠过的街道与建筑，有阳光飞洒落进眼中，旋即她微不可察的笑了笑。
眼眸中带着一丝难得的柔和之意。
车马飞驰，许久后，李洛突然睁开眼，有些疑惑的道：“这不是回家的路？”
姜青娥螓首微点，轻声道：“去一趟金龙宝行，取一个东西。”
她金色眼瞳投向李洛。
“师父师娘走之前，专门留给你的东西，说是让你十七岁时再
李洛闻言，心头顿时一震。
老爹老娘留了东西给他？
（PS：纳兰嫣然：听说你想退婚？少年你路走窄了啊。

content_en:
Four lion-horse beasts pulled the chariot and galloped smoothly on the spacious streets of Nanfeng City. The forest-like buildings on the streets retreated rapidly.
The interior of the carriage was quite spacious, warm and comfortable, and Li Luo and Jiang Qing'e were sitting on either side of the coffee table.
The two of them didn't talk much. Li Luo closed his eyes and meditated when he got in the car, while Jiang Qing'e's delicate jade-like cheeks made her cheeks even more crystal clear.
The silence lasted for a long time. Jiang Qing'e's long and thick eyelashes suddenly blinked, she raised her pretty face, her golden eyes stared at Li Luo in front of her, and said, "It seems that what I said at Nanfeng Academy a few years ago has brought you some trouble."
"I'm sorry."
Hearing this, Li Luo opened his eyes. He looked at the beautiful and delicate face in front of him, but also had an unconcealed sharpness and strength. He smiled and said, "There is no trace of sincerity in your apology."
"If you are sincere, allow me to terminate the engagement."
Jiang Qing'e flipped the pages of the book casually and said, "Is this the legendary break-up of engagement? But in the drama, shouldn't I be the one who takes the initiative to mention this? Are you going to reverse the order?"
Regarding her sudden cold humor, Li Luo was a little bit dumbfounded.
Jiang Qing'e raised her head, glanced at Li Luo, and said calmly: "What? Are you afraid that this engagement will bring you more trouble?"
Li Luo was silent for a moment, shook his head, and said: "I'm afraid of delaying you. You are a girl, why should you bear an unnecessary engagement? It's not like you don't know how this engagement came about. How many times has my father been beaten by my mother over the years because of this?"
"What my father did is ridiculous. I actually agree with being beaten, but the key point is why every time my mother beats my father, why does she have to take me with her to get a beating?!"
At the end, Li Luo also looked a little resentful.
Thinking of the scene where the elegant woman who was gentle to her, but had her hands on her waist, and her brows were upturned, beat two men in the family, one large and one young, to a pulp. Even Jiang Qing'e couldn't help but curled her rosy little mouth slightly, and then calmed down again.
"I'm not afraid." She shook her head.
Li Luo said with a headache: "Then what will you do when you meet someone you like in the future? You are just messing around."
Jiang Qing'e smiled lightly and said, "We may not meet each other. I have very high standards. Besides, you and I have already been engaged. It is impossible for me to have any thoughts about other people."
Li Luo stared at Jiang Qing'e, with a hint of anger in his voice: "Jiang Qing'e, what are you thinking about? I know that my parents are very good to you, and you are very grateful to them, but you don't need to express your gratitude in this way. Who do you think I am? Is this a tool you use to express your gratitude?"
"You agreed to this engagement, but did I agree to it?"
Li Luo's sudden anger made Jiang Qing'e startled. Her pure golden eyes stared at the former's face. She was quiet for a moment, then lowered her head slightly and said, "I'm sorry, I did not consider your feelings in this matter."
Seeing this, Li Luo said, "In that case, then this engagement..."
"But..."
Jiang Qing'e raised her pretty face, looked at Li Luo and said seriously: "You should also know what the rules are in our family. If there is a disagreement between the two parties, then there will be a fight first, and then the winner will have the right to make the decision."
This rule was set by Li Luo's mother. It has been applied to everything in the family for so many years, so every time she had a disagreement with Li Luo's father, she would roll up her sleeves and drag her father into the training room.
"So if you have serious objections to the engagement, we can go to the training room after we get home and follow the rules." Jiang Qing'e said.
Li Luo's expression suddenly stiffened, and his expression changed. Finally, he gritted his teeth, pointed at Jiang Qing'e and said angrily: "Jiang Qing'e, you don't want toThat's too much. I'm a beginner in the Ten Seal Realm. How can I fight with you, an Earthly Demon General? ! "
In this human practice, after opening the Xiang Palace, it is the foundation of the Ten Seal Realm, and after the Ten Seal Realm, it is the Xianshi Master Realm, but only after the Xiang Master Realm can this practice truly begin to enter the palace.
After the fortune teller realm, there are three major realms.
Pay homage to generals, be granted the title of marquis, and be proclaimed king.
It is too far to become a prince and become a king, and these generals are divided into two levels, the upper level is Tiangang general, and the lower level is Disha general... And Jiang Qing'e is at the level of Disha general.
Being able to reach the level of general worship at this age, Jiang Qing'e's cultivation talent has definitely shocked countless people. Some people have even speculated that the record of the youngest feudal lord in the Great Xia Kingdom may be broken by her.
But now, the evil general Jiang Qing'e wants Li Luo, who is in the Ten Seal Realm, to fight with her...
Li Luo was really worried that if she couldn't hold back her strength, she would slap him to death.
Jiang Qing'e put away the books on the table and said with some regret: "It seems that you don't agree with this method, so there is nothing we can do. "
Li Luo was trembling with anger, could the world be better? Is it so difficult for me to break off the engagement?
He leaned against the car window weakly, looking at Jiang Qing'e's smooth and delicate face, especially those golden eyes, which were so pure that they were a little intoxicating.
He sighed and his voice was much lower: "Sister Qing'e, we have been together for many years, but I understand that you don't actually have the kind of feelings between a man and a woman towards me. "
"Without emotion as the foundation, what's the point of this kind of engagement? "
Jiang Qing'e was silent for a moment and said: "Although I want to say that you are only seventeen years old tomorrow, why are you pretending to be mature..."
"But what you said does make some sense, but I don't have any interest in other people, but at least I don't reject you. "
Li Luo smiled bitterly and said: "Sister Qing'e, that engagement is more about your gratitude to my parents. I believe your feelings for them are much stronger than for me, but I really don't need this kind of gratitude. "
After saying that, Li Luo lowered his head and said slowly: "I know it may not be realistic for you to take back the engagement, but..."
He raised his head and looked directly into Jiang Qing'e's eyes, "I hope you can give yourself and me a chance. "
Li Luo paused and then said: "We can make a deal. You help me control Luo Lan Mansion before I have enough ability. If you can prevent it from suffering much loss when I take over Luo Lan Mansion, then as a thank you, how about I return the engagement to you?" "
Jiang Qing'e didn't speak, but her slender jade fingers gently moved rhythmically on the table. The silence lasted for a long time, and finally she whispered: "Li Luo, you really don't like me? "
Li Luo hesitated, then took a deep breath and said: "Sister Qing'e, you may have underestimated your attractiveness and excellence. For people of this age group, your charm is killing. If I said I didn't like it, it would be really contrary to my will and hypocrisy. "
"But I don't need this kind of engagement. "
Jiang Qing'e raised her eyebrows slightly and suddenly slapped her little hand on the coffee table.
Li Luo was startled and quickly moved his buttocks back, saying: "Let's discuss it carefully, but don't do anything. "
Jiang Qing'e rolled her eyes at him and said calmly: "Li Luo, I haven't seen you for a while. You are very eloquent, but what you said makes some sense. I can treat this matter as a deal. When you take over the Luo Lan Mansion, I will hand it over to you in its entirety. At that time, you will return the engagement to me. "
Hearing this, Li Luo breathed a sigh of relief, but at the same time, in the deepest part of his heart, he felt some inexplicable loss uncontrollably, which made him curse himself secretly, what a bitch...
"What you said today really surprised me.It seems you are no longer a child. "
Li Luo was a little angry: "Child? Where am I young? "
Jiang Qing'e ignored his words, just stared at him with a half-smile, and said: "But Li Luo, I have to remind you at the end, do you really plan to carry out this transaction? Once you withdraw from this engagement, I'm afraid you will have no hope at all in this life. "
Li Luo narrowed his eyes, pressed his arms on the coffee table, straightened up, and looked directly down at Jiang Qing'e. The distance between their faces was only about half a foot.
"Jiang Qing'e, I really don't care about this engagement at all, because in the future, I want you to give it to me with your own hands, not to my parents. "
Jiang Qing'e's golden eyes reflected Li Luo's handsome face, and the half-smile on her lips became stronger. Of course she understood what Li Luo meant. The reason why this engagement was returned to her was because she did not like him as a man and a woman now. When she gave the engagement to Li Luo again in the future, it meant that she fell in love with him.
"Sit down. "Her red lips parted slightly.
An inexplicable force appeared out of thin air, directly pushing Li Luo's butt back, and he sat heavily on the car board. The force made the latter grin uncontrollably.
The previous momentum was instantly broken.
Jiang Qing'e cupped her cheeks, glanced at Li Luo lazily, and said: "I'm not very capable, but my tone is not small. I've seen many talented people in recent years, but no one dares to say such things to me. "
"Li Luo, don't be too ambitious. Your goal is too unrealistic, but if you really want to try it, I might as well give you a chance. "
Her golden eyes were shiny, mysterious and deep.
"I'm waiting for you at Shengxuanxing Academy... This is the first step, and if you can't even reach this point, you can treat these words today as the rebellious spirit of youth, and then forget about it. "
Li Luo didn't say anything more this time, he just leaned against the car window, his eyes gradually closed, and said calmly: "Then just wait. "
Jiang Qing'e's eyes were looking at the streets and buildings passing by outside the crack of the car window. Sunlight was shining into her eyes, and she smiled imperceptibly.
There was a rare softness in his eyes.
The carriages and horses were speeding, and after a long time, Li Luo suddenly opened his eyes and said with some confusion: "Isn't this the way home? "
Jiang Qing'e nodded slightly and said softly: "Go to Jinlong Baoxing to pick up something. "
Her golden eyes turned to Li Luo.
"Before Master and Master left, I left something specifically for you. It was said to be for you to re-enter when you are seventeen years old.
When Li Luo heard this, his heart suddenly shook.
Did mom and dad leave something for him?
(PS: Nalan Yanran: I heard that you want to break off the engagement? Young man, you are on a narrow road.
